chunks: Ibn Bukayr narrated from Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a woman whose husband has died: "Can she perform hajj during her waiting period ('iddah)?" He said: "Yes."

key_terms.نَعَمْ: yes; an explicit affirmative legal answer
key_terms.يُتَوَفَّى: passes away; refers here to the husband’s death
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a widow perform hajj during her 'iddah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a woman whose husband has died may perform hajj during her 'iddah. It indicates that the waiting period after widowhood does not prevent her from undertaking the pilgrimage.
